definitions.explanation: Large waves on the ocean, especially those caused by wind. A formal or technical term commonly used in weather reports and maritime contexts.

examples.japanese: {波浪警報|はろうけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A high wave warning has been issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{波浪|はろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The waves are high due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {波浪注意報|はろうちゅういほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{漁船|ぎょせん}→漁船：22594_gyosen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出港|しゅっこう}→出港：11764_shukkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見合|みあ}わせた→見合わせる：09450_miawaseru⟧。
examples.english: Because a wave advisory was issued, the fishing boats postponed their departure.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in weather reports as {波浪警報|はろうけいほう} (high wave warning) or {波浪注意報|はろうちゅういほう} (wave advisory). In everyday speech, ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧ (waves) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波浪警報|はろうけいほう} (high wave warning)
- {波浪注意報|はろうちゅういほう} (wave advisory)
- {波浪|はろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (waves are high)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧: waves — general everyday term
- ⟦{高波|たかなみ}→高波：19938_takanami⟧: high waves — more accessible than {波浪|はろう}
